newsitem.title: UK: UK's Raving Loony lays 15 million-to-one bet.
newsitem.headline: UK's Raving Loony lays 15 million-to-one bet.

text.p: A renowned British eccentric has made betting history by staking five pounds ($8) at odds of 15 million-to-one that he will be the country's next prime minister, bookmakers William Hill said on Thursday.
It said the odds offered to Screaming Lord Sutch, leader of the Monster Raving Loony Party, were the longest in the history of betting.
Sutch and his party, fighting under the motto "Vote for insanity -- you know it makes sense", have taken part in nearly 40 local and general elections since 1963 and have failed to win a single seat.

Sutch will be campaigning hard in a national election set for May 1 but will be hard pressed to beat Tony Blair, whose opposition Labour Party enjoys a commanding opinion poll lead over the ruling Conservatives.

William Hill said one punter had bet 20 pounds at odds of 500-1 that the Conservatives would be reduced to less than 10 seats at the election. They currently hold 321 in the 651-seat House of Commons.
